title: Horizon and Current
author: Gideon Okafor
blurb: Astrid Villalobos, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
